The error occurs in `will_of_the_prophets/views.py` within the `RollView.get_context_data` method. Specifically, when no rolls exist in the database, `models.Roll.objects.order_by("-embargo").first()` returns `None`. The code then attempts to access `last_roll.embargo` to instantiate a `board.Board` object, resulting in an `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'embargo'`.

To resolve this, `get_context_data` must be updated to handle the case where `last_roll` is `None`. 

If `last_roll` is `None`, the `board` argument passed to `super().get_context_data` should be initialized using a default time (likely the current time) instead of `last_roll.embargo`. Since `board.Board.__init__` in `will_of_the_prophets/board.py` already defaults to `timezone.now()` if `now` is not provided, simply passing `now=None` (or omitting the argument) when `last_roll` is `None` will fix the crash.
